title: Escape attempts and what happens to men caught in Mississippi
summary: Few escapes succeed; men caught are sent back, or serve time in Mississippi first for a new crime.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, now, how do you get out? I mean, once you go, you can't cross the Mississippi Canyon.

Well, it had been some tried it, didn't make it. It had been some tried it and made it. Some tried it on the way, some got caught on the way, and some went across to the other side and still got caught.
Do they ever head up for the state of Mississippi?
Some of them get caught in Mississippi. And what do they do?
They send them back or they send them to Portugal?

They send them back where they left for. I see. One way they send them to Mississippi, and that is they get over in Mississippi after running off from here and admit another crime over there, and the laws catch them for the crime they admit there, and they'll send them there when they finish his time. He come back here and finish what he left him.
